scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tierra-sim/engine && npm run build --workspace @tierra-sim/runner && npm run build --workspace @tierra-sim/app
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @tierra-sim/engine && npm run test --workspace @tierra-sim/runner && npm run test --workspace @tierra-sim/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @tierra-sim/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @tierra-sim/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @tierra-sim/runner && npm run typecheck --workspace @tierra-sim/app
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.demo: npm run build && node runner/dist/cli.js demo
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && node runner/dist/cli.js benchmark
scripts.calibrate: npm run build && node runner/dist/cli.js calibrate
scripts.run:headless: npm run build && node runner/dist/cli.js run
scripts.fixture:digest: npm run build && node runner/dist/cli.js fixture-digest
scripts.app: npm run build --workspace @tierra-sim/engine && npm run dev --workspace @tierra-sim/app
